params.name: Darron Pike
params.purpose: Check carrying harnesses and keep ordinary shared yard duties safe for animals, handlers and visitors.
params.personality: Broad-humoured, patient and teasing, attentive to animals and straightforward about what he has not seen.
params.background: A regular worker at Thistlebell Yard in Orchard Vales, with his own professional obligations and independent local life.
params.witness: a broad-shouldered handler checked a pack beast's harness

scene: At 08:30 in Thistlebell Yard, Maddoc is talking to a regular beast handler. The older neighbour heard Maddoc say he wanted to become a Soul cultivator. The yard handler heard Maddoc joke about a secret sibling while seeking Hedra and Nessa. Neither parent has been located. The worker suggested asking other handlers; neither acquaintance has told Maddoc a given name.
summary: Maddoc has met an older neighbour by his family's lane and a worker at Thistlebell Yard. Both are real independent locals, not guaranteed on future visits; each heard only their own conversation. Their personal names have not been spoken to Maddoc.
focus: At Thistlebell Yard; ask other handlers about parents
Minor locals may remember Maddoc but are not guaranteed present

continuity.statement: The older orchard-lane neighbour heard Maddoc introduce himself, ask after Hedra and Nessa, and say he wanted to become a Soul cultivator. She had not seen the parents and suggested the yard.
continuity.witness: The older neighbour heard Maddoc say he wanted to become a Soul cultivator

continuity.statement: The Thistlebell handler heard Maddoc joke about the possibility of a secret sibling while searching for Hedra and Nessa. He had not seen the parents that morning and suggested asking other handlers.
continuity.witness: The yard handler heard Maddoc joke about a secret sibling while seeking Hedra and Nessa
